summary: Nora now recognises unsettled plans as something to write down, so her notebook can start from empty.
details: The note tier shipped switched on but never wrote a note: with an empty notebook the <notes> block is absent from every prompt, so nothing told her the notebook existed. Her doctrine now carries the recognition directly, which does not depend on a note already existing.
limitations: Nothing merges, retires or promotes notes yet — the curator is still unbuilt, so the notebook only grows.
